path_step: User views the list of connected participants
test_scenario: Verify that a user (Teacher or Student) can view the list of all connected participants in a live video session.
test_case_title: Verify user can view connected participants list
pre_condition: Teacher and at least one Student are logged in, enrolled in the course, and have joined an active video session.
expected_result: The side menu displays an accurate list of all connected participants for both Teacher and Student.
post_condition: The user has successfully viewed the list of participants.

test_steps.step: Teacher verifies the list of connected users, including the student.
Student verifies the list of connected users, including the teacher.

uncovered_conditions: Normal Flow: Common Action 3 (User can view the list of connected participants)
